messages.subject: Paid INLA support request
parts:
We are using R-INLA within a Bayesian Hierarchical Model (BHM) to solve the sea level budget at a global scale, which involves multiple satellite and in-situ observations and a number of latent processes (roughly 5-7 depending on the set up). This is part of a 6 year project called GlobalMass (www.globalmass.eu) that is nearing its end. The person who developed the BHM has left the project and we urgently need some support from someone with experience using R-INLA for environmental science (i.e. spatio-temporal) problems. We can offer up to 1.0 FTE until August 2023 for this support so if you are at the end of a contract or have some spare capacity to work on an exciting but challenging problem please get in touch. The team is based at University of Bristol but remote working is possible of course and the PI is also based at Technical University Munich.

Jonathan Bamber (j.ba...@bristol.ac.uk or j.ba...@tum.de)
